name: Frill
desc: Collect feedback, manage ideas, and publish announcements with Frill.

actions.name: create_idea
actions.description: Create a new feedback idea or feature request in Frill.

actions.name: update_idea
actions.description: Update an existing idea, including status, topics, or archive flag.

actions.name: create_comment
actions.description: Add a public comment or internal note to an existing idea.

actions.name: create_announcement
actions.description: Publish a changelog or product update announcement.

actions.name: create_follower
actions.description: Add a new user (follower) to Frill, optionally with custom attributes and company data.

actions.name: update_follower
actions.description: Update an existing user (follower), including custom attributes and company associations.

actions.name: get_ideas
actions.description: Fetch a list of ideas/feedback entries from Frill.

actions.name: get_comments
actions.description: Fetch comments for a specific idea or all recent comments.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_idea
triggers.description: Triggers when a new idea or feedback entry is created in Frill.

triggers.name: new_comment
triggers.description: Triggers when a new public comment or internal note is added in Frill.
